R_rule.words: per arm, from that arm's R = 1 smoke: t_round = work_cycles.max / 4 (the busiest shire's rounds at R = 1) / 600 MHz; predicted kernel seconds of R passes = busiest(R) x t_round + copy_cycles_max / 600 MHz; R = 96 if that is at most 6 s, else the largest allowed R that is; no burst for the arm if none is

_what: E202's plan (plan_e202.py), frozen with the registration; the kit runs it, never re-draws it

bursts.coop4: NOT BUILT: no arm (the design's REPORTED coop4 arm is dropped)
bursts.form: each burst: the die gate, 8 s at rest, ONE host process (one launch of R passes, under timeout 10, never -k), 10 s at rest; the sampler at 10 Hz throughout (no statistics reset)

reported.configs: the dram pair, only when the scp pair is scored

scored.configs: the scored pair's trained (T) and random (Z) configurations

card: aifoundry3 card 0 (/dev/et0_*, /run/lock/etsoc-shire0.lock) at its pinned 600 MHz, reads only, nothing set

card_time_minutes.words: no burst starts after 33 card-minutes from the first card command; the session ends by 35

die_gate.below_means: not a block: scored given its own T0 and labelled so

post: waived: the owner's standing words of Sun 15 Nov 2026 10:22:36 PST

predicted_peak.rule: plan_e202.py refuses (exit 3) unless every configuration's band-top board watts lie under the 65 W stop

smoke.accuracy_expected: the ACC launch's labels equal the model's expected file (its core check); the trained network's test accuracy is then the model's, 98.49% (desk, measured)
smoke.gate: an arm's smoke passes when its host result reads core_status PASS (every record, label line, checksum, discard line and operation count; tensor_error 0); a logits_status FAIL with core_status PASS is a debug-path defect, recorded, not a gate failure; the scored pair is scp when T-scp and Z-scp both pass, else dram when T-dram and Z-dram both pass (the registered fallback), else no burst runs (no data, never a failed forecast)

stops.clock: every sample 600 MHz: the first sample off it sets its burst aside, a second stops the session
stops.words: a stop ends the queue: the running process finishes (a device process is never killed), nothing further starts, the closing reads, release

window: G = the card lane's booking of aifoundry3 on its day; last start G + 1:30, last end G + 3:30, both rounded up to the minute, inside that Pacific day; G at 20:29:00 PST or earlier; after E201 and its 40-minute rest; one session of ours on aifoundry3 at a time
